qualifier: from DHA, EPA and DPA (resolvins, protectins, maresins)
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis from DHA/EPA/DPA
rationale: All members synthesize resolvins, protectins, maresins or related oxo-derivatives from omega-3 (and DPA) fatty acids, unlike confusables that make arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotrienes.

qualifier: FGFR/PDGFR/ALK-family fusions and amplifications
name: FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK kinase fusions and amplifications in cancer
rationale: Members are cancer-driving FGFR, PDGFR, ALK and LTK alterations dominated by fusions, translocations and amplifications, whereas confusables cover EGFR/ERBB2/PDGFRA point mutants, cytosolic fusions or TKI-resistant ALK mutants.

qualifier: with mRNA stabilization and translation under stress
name: Stress granule dynamics and stress-induced mRNA stabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly, PKR and arsenite stress, and mRNA-stabilizing or translation-promoting RNA binding, unlike confusables centred on ARE-mediated mRNA destabilization and decay.

qualifier: excision repair, translesion synthesis and nucleobase editing, not double-strand breaks
name: Excision repair, translesion synthesis and nucleobase editing
rationale: Members span base and nucleotide excision repair, mismatch repair, translesion synthesis, damage reversal, DNA demethylation and cytidine/adenosine deamination (incl. somatic hypermutation), while confusables are double-strand break, homologous recombination and telomere pathways.

core: Negative regulation of T cell activation
qualifier: alpha-beta T cells and IFN-gamma production
name: Suppression of alpha-beta T cell activation and IFN-gamma production
rationale: All three members restrain CD4/CD8 alpha-beta T cell activation or proliferation and type II interferon output, unlike confusables about positive T cell regulation, Th/Treg differentiation or other cytokines.

qualifier: lens, anterior eye and retinal vascular barriers
name: Eye morphogenesis, lens and retinal vascular barrier formation
rationale: Members cover structural eye development (optic cup, lens, iris, cornea, eyelid, RPE) and ocular vasculature and blood-retinal barrier, unlike confusables about photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation and phototransduction or retinoid metabolism.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: All members describe adrenergic (alpha-2) or Gz/Gi signaling that inhibits adenylate cyclase, distinct from confusables on general adrenoceptors, cAMP turnover, or serotonin and muscarinic receptors.

qualifier: activation, inactivation and recovery signaling
name: Phototransduction cascade activation, inactivation and recovery
rationale: Members concern light detection and the activation/shut-off of the phototransduction cascade, whereas confusables cover the retinoid cycle, opsin pigments and light absorption, or photoreceptor development.

qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants
name: Mismatch repair defects and TGF-beta/SMAD cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine mismatch repair and its defective forms with TGFBR/SMAD and TCF7L2 mutants typical of microsatellite-unstable cancer, unlike confusables on Hippo/RUNX3, TGFBR3, base excision repair or somatic hypermutation.

qualifier: AMPA/kainate receptors and G-protein presynaptic modulation
name: Kainate/AMPA receptor transmission and G-beta-gamma presynaptic modulation
rationale: Members cover AMPA and kainate receptor activation, presynaptic depolarization and G-beta-gamma regulation of Ca2+ and K+ channels, distinct from confusables on nicotinic receptors, NMDA receptor/LTP signaling or presynaptic secretion control.

qualifier: capping, severing and crosslinking by actin-binding proteins
name: Actin filament capping, severing and crosslinking
rationale: Members concern direct actin filament capping, severing, bundling and network assembly and adhesion-linked cytoskeleton remodeling, whereas confusables are Rho-family GTPase cycles and protrusion signaling.

core: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension
qualifier: axial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover non-canonical Wnt/PCP signaling, convergent extension, notochord/axial mesoderm and neural plate/floor plate morphogenesis, unlike confusables on Wnt ligand secretion and Ca2+ signaling, Hedgehog, or left-right asymmetry.

qualifier: with alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism
name: Fructose catabolism and gluconeogenesis from alanine/oxaloacetate
rationale: Members cover fructose breakdown and its disorders plus gluconeogenic alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism, distinct from confusables on glycerol/alditol metabolism and glucose-6-phosphatase or glycogen regulation.

qualifier: anti-inflammatory IL-10 and anti-protozoan responses
name: Macrophage anti-inflammatory and anti-protozoan host defense
rationale: Members center on macrophage IL-10/anti-inflammatory signaling, NADPH oxidase, GBP and responses to leishmania and other pathogens, distinct from confusables on neutrophil respiratory burst, bacterial toxin uptake or Mtb manipulation of host cells.

qualifier: RUNX1-directed myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages
name: RUNX1-directed myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte hematopoiesis
rationale: Members cover stem/progenitor maintenance and myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation with RUNX1 transcription and CSF signaling, unlike confusables on cytokine JAK-STAT signaling, Th2/mast cell responses or lymphocyte activation.

qualifier: ER glucose-6-phosphate transport and its deficiency disorders
name: Glucose-6-phosphatase/G6P translocase system and its deficiencies
rationale: All members concern ER glucose-6-phosphate transport and hydrolysis (G6PC, G6PC3, SLC37A4) and their diseases, unlike confusables on fructose, glycogen synthesis/breakdown or glucokinase.

qualifier: insulin/glucagon action on target tissues, not insulin secretion
name: Insulin/glucagon target-tissue regulation of glucose and glycogen metabolism
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor and glucagon/PKA signaling, glucose uptake, glycogen and gluconeogenesis control and glucose-sensing transcription, whereas confusables focus on insulin secretion, lipogenesis or fructose bisphosphate glycolytic control.

core: Transcriptional control of adipogenesis and lipid metabolism
qualifier: PPAR, LXR, SREBP and ChREBP gene programs
name: Transcriptional control of adipocyte differentiation and lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and nuclear-receptor, SREBP, ChREBP and clock-driven metabolic gene expression, unlike confusables on thermogenesis and fatty acid transport or glucagon/PKA signaling.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, lipoylation and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, lipoylation and Fe-S clusters
rationale: Members cover TCA cycle reactions, OGDH/PDH/OADH complexes and their lipoyl and Fe-S cofactor maturation, distinct from confusables on CoA/pantothenate biosynthesis and PDH regulation or vitamin B6 and serine metabolism.

qualifier: dentinogenesis, enamel and cementum formation
name: Bone and dental tissue mineralization and tooth development
rationale: Members concern bone, enamel, dentin and cementum mineralization and odontogenesis with FGF23-Klotho and PTH regulation, unlike confusables on Na-phosphate transport or osteoclast-driven resorption.

qualifier: priming, polymerase switching and flap removal, including telomere C-strand
name: Lagging-strand DNA synthesis including telomere C-strand replication
rationale: All members describe primer synthesis, polymerase switching, strand elongation and Okazaki flap removal in replication, unlike confusables on translesion synthesis, base excision or nucleotide excision repair.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium
name: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium differentiation
rationale: Members mark differentiated intestinal/hepatic absorptive epithelium, crypt stem cells and pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages, unlike confusables on early pancreatic progenitors and endoderm, antimicrobial defense or lung epithelium.

qualifier: H2O2-induced and ligand-independent death signaling
name: Regulation of oxidative stress-induced and ligand-independent apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic apoptosis triggered by hydrogen peroxide, oxidative stress or hypoxia and ligand-independent extrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables on nitrosative stress, ferroptosis or general peroxide responses.

qualifier: bacterial attachment, host-cell entry and toxin uptake
name: Bacterial attachment, host-cell invasion and toxin entry
rationale: Members are dominated by bacterial adhesion and invasion (Listeria), Gram-positive responses and anthrax/diphtheria toxin entry, distinct from confusables on macrophage IL-10 responses, phagosome manipulation by Mtb or protozoan defense.

qualifier: initiation and replication-stress checkpoint
name: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and replication-stress checkpoint
rationale: Members cover initiation and regulation of mitotic DNA replication with ATR-mediated replication checkpoint and E2F1 targets, unlike confusables on pre-replicative complex assembly, DNA unwinding or general cell-cycle modules.
